definitions.explanation: A leisure activity of going to an orchard to pick and eat apples, popular as an autumn outing.

examples.english: We went apple picking in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧りんご{狩|が}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{農園|のうえん}→農園：26824_nouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}{制限|せいげん}→時間制限：26085_jikanseigen⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧りんご{狩|が}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: At this orchard you can enjoy apple picking with no time limit.

notes:
Formed from ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧ (apple) + {狩|が}り (gathering, picking), with rendaku making it ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧. The suffix {狩|が}り is used for going out to gather or pick produce, as in ぶどう{狩|が}り (grape picking) and いちご{狩|が}り (strawberry picking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- りんご{狩|が}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: go apple picking
- りんご{狩|が}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: enjoy apple picking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧: clam digging — another {狩|が}り outing
- ぶどう{狩|が}り: grape picking — a parallel fruit-picking activity
